f3_program: collection("dinner.pizzas", "pizza", "pizzeria", source("had dinner at their favorite pizzeria. They decide to share 2 pizzas"))
observe(at("dinner.pizzas.count", "initial"), 2, "count", source("share 2 pizzas"))
collection("dinner.pizza_slices", "slice", "dinner.pizzas", source("each pizza is cut into 12 slices"))
observe(at("dinner.pizza_slices.per_pizza.count", "current"), 12, "count", source("each pizza is cut into 12 slices"))
consume("bob_eats_pizza", "bob", at("dinner.pizza_slices.count", "current"), fraction(at("dinner.pizza_slices.per_pizza.count", "current"), 1, 2), source("Bob ate half of a pizza"))
consume("tom_eats_pizza", "tom", at("dinner.pizza_slices.count", "current"), fraction(at("dinner.pizza_slices.per_pizza.count", "current"), 1, 3), source("Tom ate one-third of a pizza"))

consume("sally_eats_pizza", "sally", at("dinner.pizza_slices.count", "current"), fraction(at("dinner.pizza_slices.per_pizza.count", "current"), 1, 6), source("Sally wasn't very hungry and only ate one-sixth of a pizza"))
consume("jerry_eats_pizza", "jerry", at("dinner.pizza_slices.count", "current"), fraction(at("dinner.pizza_slices.per_pizza.count", "current"), 1, 4), source("Jerry ate a quarter of a pizza"))
query("remaining_count", "dinner.pizza_slices", "current")

f3_program: collection("food_bank.food", "food", "food_bank", source("food bank to collect food"))
observe(at("food_bank.donations.weight", "week_1"), 40, "pound", source("40 pounds of food were donated to the food bank by the people of her local town"))

add("week_1_donation", "people_of_local_town", at("food_bank.food.weight", "current"), at("food_bank.donations.weight", "week_1"), source("40 pounds of food were donated to the food bank by the people of her local town"))
add("week_2_donation", "people_of_local_town", at("food_bank.food.weight", "current"), scale(event_field("week_1_donation", "quantity"), 2), source("donations were twice as high as the first week"))

transfer("week_3_distribution", "lyanna", at("food_bank.food.weight", "current"), at("homeless_people.food.weight", "current"), fraction(at("food_bank.food.weight", "current"), 70, 100), source("she gave out 70% of the donated food to the homeless in the third week"))
query("value", at("food_bank.food.weight", "current"))

assumptions: The requested value depends on the unstated number of tires on each car, an external ontology fact that F3-v1 does not allow annotators to invent.

f3_program: collection("rainbow_preschool.students", "student", "rainbow_preschool", source("At Rainbow Preschool, there are 80 students"))
observe(at("rainbow_preschool.students.count", "current"), 80, "count", source("there are 80 students"))
percent_of(at("rainbow_preschool.students.half_day.count", "current"), at("rainbow_preschool.students.count", "current"), 25, source("25% of them are half-day students"))

difference_relation(at("rainbow_preschool.students.full_day.count", "current"), at("rainbow_preschool.students.count", "current"), at("rainbow_preschool.students.half_day.count", "current"), source("the rest are full-day students"))
query("value", at("rainbow_preschool.students.full_day.count", "current"))
